hook.name: ForgeFeeHook
hook.description: Flat 0.05% (5 bps) fee hook for Forge-launched pools. On buys (ETH→token), takes the fee from the input in beforeSwap; on sells (token→ETH), takes the fee from the output in afterSwap — both routed directly to a per-pool feeRecipient address. Only exact-input swaps are accepted. Pool initialization is restricted to a bound factory address set once by the owner.
